name: War-Awoken Kaleido Water (Weapon Skill)
name_jp: 戦醒カレイドウォーター
effects: One single attack (11.00 or 31.00 each) capped at 199,999 based on ATK and MAG. Grants [Water Damage Cap +20000 (Tactical)], [Water 125% ATB Quick Cycle (Tactical)], [Instant ATB 1], [Instant Cast 1] to user, grants [Buff Water 50% (15s)] to all allies if user has Water Damage buff, grants [Dualcast Water 3], [Water Ability Instant Cast 3], [Weakness +30% Boost 3] to user if not.
